technical.summary: Short-term momentum signals (RSI, MACD crossovers, volume spike) show bullish initiation, but weak trend structure (low ADX), price below key moving averages, and negative Ichimoku positioning limit conviction for a high-probability swing entry.

fundamental.summary: FCX shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk in 97 days.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (26/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is minimal and mixed with no conviction signal from senior members.

risk.summary: Severe macro deterioration: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (325.28) indicates extreme market stress, strong dollar headwind pressures FCX as multinational commodity producer, and credit stress environment constrains financing—earnings in 97 days provides minimal near-term event risk but macro backdrop is highly unfavourable.

debate.key_bull_argument: Short-term momentum (RSI rising, MACD crossover, 15x volume spike) with price near support (26.6251) and extreme fear sentiment (26/100) creates contrarian entry opportunity for tactical swing trade.
debate.key_bear_argument: Fundamental deterioration (earnings risk high, no smart money conviction), severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, strong dollar), price below all key moving averages (50-SMA, 200-SMA, Ichimoku cloud), and weak trend structure (ADX false, Hull MA not bullish) make this a low-probability entry despite momentum signals.

decision.entry_rationale: Short-term momentum signals (RSI rising, MACD crossover, 15x volume spike) and extreme fear sentiment (26/100) create a contrarian setup at support.
